description.zh: 在对话中查看个人邮箱、筛选未读/发件人/日期、阅读正文，并用专家技能分析与起草回复；发送走连接器两阶段确认。
description.en: Browse your personal mailbox in chat — filter unread/from/date, read messages, analyze and draft replies with expert skills; send via connector two-phase confirmation.

welcome_message.zh: 请先在「连接器」中配置个人邮箱并完成探测，再选择该连接器。需要我列出收件箱，或帮你分析/回复某封邮件吗？
welcome_message.en: Configure your personal mailbox under Connectors and complete the probe, then select that connector. Shall I list your inbox, or analyze/reply to a message?

description.zh: 用邮件卡片展示收件箱近期邮件（模型只附一两句摘要）
description.en: Show recent inbox in a mail card (caption only, no table)

prompt.zh: 请用 search_emails 列出我收件箱最近的邮件并用邮件卡片展示；回复只要一两句摘要，不要再输出表格或逐封列表。
prompt.en: List my recent inbox with search_emails in the mail card; reply with a 1–2 line caption only — no Markdown table or per-message dump.

prompt.zh: 请列出我的未读邮件（unread=true）并用卡片展示；回复只要一两句摘要，不要表格。
prompt.en: List my unread emails (unread=true) in the mail card; 1–2 line caption only, no table.

description.zh: 引导去连接器配置个人邮箱
description.en: Guide to Connectors for personal mailbox setup

prompt.zh: 请告诉我如何在连接器中配置个人邮箱并完成探测，以便使用邮件专家。
prompt.en: Please explain how to configure my personal mailbox in Connectors and complete the probe so I can use the Mail Expert.

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」汇总未读邮件主题列表（只读，不自动回复）
每周一「10:00」列出过去 7 天来自指定发件人的邮件摘要
en: Every weekday at 09:00, summarize unread subjects (read-only, never auto-reply)
Every Monday at 10:00, summarize emails from a given sender over the past 7 days
